title: Quad9&\#x27;s France exit and the argument against DNS piracy blocking
summary: Public DNS resolver Quad9&\#x27;s reported exit from France is the hook for a TechStackUps article arguing that DNS resolvers are the wrong place to enforce copyright. The piece is an opinion/analysis argument, not a report of a new resolver capability or an independent measurement, and the supplied material does not include the article text or Quad9&\#x27;s announcement. As a result, the specific French order, its timing, and the scope of the withdrawal are not established here.
